thesis: Decision-critical historical facts are well supported by the uploaded Q2 FY2026 10-Q and the Q3 FY2026 earnings release. Revenue, ARR, RPO, OCF, debt, cash, SBC, buybacks and share counts are directly observable. Main uncertainty is the modeled long-run AI monetization and FCF path, not the historical evidence.

evidence.claim: Q2/H1 revenue, operating income and net income are directly reported in the Q2 10-Q.
Q2 cash+ST investments $5.626B, debt $6.645B and H1 OCF $5.123B are filing-backed.
Q3 revenue $6.76B, ARR $27.50B, AI-first ARR >150% y/y and Q3 OCF $2.52B are company-reported.

counterevidence: AI-first ARR is company-defined and its incremental economics are not fully disclosed.
falsifiers: Source mismatch or later filings that contradict the frozen facts require rerun.
